contacts.name: Dana Iyer
contacts.title: Head of Operations
contacts.notes: The original sponsor for the pilot proposal.

activities.body: Exploratory call with Dana Iyer (Head of Operations). She described an internal approvals bottleneck: claims adjustments wait on a small number of named approvers.
Proposal sent for a single-agent pilot on the approvals queue.
Dana Iyer presented the proposal to Northgate's operations committee. She reported the feedback as positive. No decision was recorded at the committee and none has reached us in writing.
Dana Iyer said budget for the pilot 'should land next cycle'. She did not name a cycle or a date.
Dana Iyer has left Northgate Mutual. No successor sponsor has been named to us.
